{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year = 2025–26 |team = Ohio Bobcats |sport=Basketball |image = Ohio Bobcats wordmark.svg |image_size = 150 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = |short_conf = MAC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 15–17 |conf_record = 9–9 |head_coach = [[Jeff Boals]] |hc_year = 7th |asst_coach1 = Lamar Thornton |ac1_year = 7th |asst_coach2 = Kyle Barlow |ac2_year = 7th |asst_coach3 = Lee Martin |ac3_year = 6th |asst_coach4 = Casey Crawford |ac4_year = 1st |stadium = [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] |tourney = |tourney_result = |champion = }} {{2025–26 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2025–26 Ohio University Bobcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio University]] for the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bobcats were led by seventh-year head coach [[Jeff Boals]], who was a 1995 graduate of Ohio University.{{cite web|url=https://ohiobobcats.com/sports/mbball/roster/coaches/jeff-boals/132|title=Jeff Boals|website=Ohio University Athletics|language=en|access-date=May 15, 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/coaches/jeff-boals-1.html|title=Jeff Boals|website=Sports Reference|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}} They play their home games at the [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] in [[Athens, Ohio]], as a member of the [[Mid-American Conference]].{{cite web |url=https://www.ohio.edu/building-directory/convocation-center|title=Convocation Center|website=Ohio University|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2026/group/14|title=MAC Men's College Basketball Standings – 2025–26|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2023-05-19}} They finished the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2025–26 season]] 15–17, 9–9 in [[2025–26 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]], to finish tied for 5th place.{{Cite web |title=2025-26 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2026/group/14 |access-date=March 13, 2026 |work=ESPN}} The Bobcats struggled to a 1–6 record to open the season. They qualified for the [[2026 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] as the 6th seed where they lost in the quarterfinals to [[2025–26 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]]{{Cite web |title=Kent State 86, Ohio 75 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401858189/ohio-kent-state |access-date=March 13, 2026 |date=March 12, 2026|work=ESPN}} This was Ohio's first losing season in Boals' tenure at Ohio and the first since the [[2018–19 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|2018–19 season]]. == Previous season == {{Main|2024–25 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team}} The Bobcats were picked to win the conference but finished with a 16–16 record. They posted a disappointing 6–6 record entering 2025 prior to the start of league play. They finished tied for fourth in the [[2024–25 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC]] with a 10–8 conference record and lost their January matchup in the MAC-SBC challenge.{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2025/group/14|title=MAC Men's College Basketball Standings - 2025-25|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2025-03-15}} With a first round loss to [[2024–25 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]], they failed to reach the [[2025 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] semifinals for the first time since [[2020 MAC men's basketball tournament|2020]] when the tournament was cancelled due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|coronavirus pandemic]].{{cite news |title=Mid-American Conference cancels basketball tournament in Cleveland because of coronavirus concerns |url=https://www.cleveland.com/sports/2020/03/mid-american-conference-cancels-mens-and-womens-basketball-tournament.html |newspaper=[[The Plain Dealer]] |date=March 12, 2020 |author=Wright, Branson |accessdate=March 12, 2020}}{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401745814/ohio-toledo|title=Ohio 85, Toledo 90|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2025-03-15}} == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" |+ style="{{CollegeSecondaryStyle|Ohio Bobcats}}" | Departures |- align=center !
